statements.statement: SELECT * FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO = ? FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO = ? ORDER BY ORLN
SELECT COUNT(*) AS LINECNT FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO = ?
SELECT * FROM {lib}.RCM WHERE CONO = ? AND CUST LIKE ? AND CUNAME LIKE ? ORDER BY CUST FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.HPH WHERE CONO = ? AND PONO LIKE ? AND VNAME LIKE ? ORDER BY PODATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM LIKE ? AND ITDSC LIKE ? ORDER BY ITEM, WH FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.LLH WHERE CONO = ? AND LHNO LIKE ? ORDER BY SHIPDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT YM, SUM(REVENUE) AS REVENUE, SUM(ORDERS) AS ORDERS, SUM(LINES) AS LINES FROM {lib}.SSH WHERE CONO = ? AND YM >= ? AND YM <= ? GROUP BY YM ORDER BY YM FETCH FIRST 24 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IIM WHERE ITEM LIKE ? AND ITDSC LIKE ? ORDER BY ITEM FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IIM WHERE ITEM = ? FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE ITEM = ? ORDER BY WH FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.HPO WHERE ITEM = ? ORDER BY ODATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ITEM = ? ORDER BY ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT CONO, ORNO, CUST, SHIP, HID, HSTAT, CHSTS1, CHSTS2, CHSTS3, CHSTS4, CHSTS5, ORDTE, REQDTE FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ? AND CUST LIKE ? AND ORNO LIKE ? AND ORDTE >= ? AND ORDTE <= ? ORDER BY ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ITEM, ITDSC, WH, UOM, IOHB, IISSU, IRCT, IADJU, (IOHB - IISSU + IRCT + IADJU) AS AVAILABLE, ISFQ AS SAFETY_STOCK FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ? AND (IOHB - IISSU + IRCT + IADJU) < ISFQ ORDER BY (IOHB - IISSU + IRCT + IADJU) ASC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ECH.ORNO) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(ECL.QTORD * ECL.PRICE) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM {lib}.ECH JOIN {lib}.ECL ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE ECH.CONO = ? GROUP BY ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, SUM(ECL.QTORD) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(ECL.QTORD * ECL.PRICE) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM {lib}.ECL LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON ECL.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE ECL.CONO = ? GROUP BY ECL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ITEM, WH, ITTYP, QTY, REFNO, TRNDTE, TRNTME, USERID, DBNAM, SERNO FROM {lib}.ITL WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM LIKE ? AND TRNDTE >= ? AND TRNDTE <= ? ORDER BY TRNDTE DESC, TRNTME DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT HPH.PONO, HPH.VNAME, HPH.PODATE, HPO.ITEM, HPO.ITDSC, HPO.QTYORD, HPO.QTYRCV, (HPO.QTYORD - HPO.QTYRCV) AS QTYOPEN, HPO.UPRICE, HPO.LREQDTE FROM {lib}.HPH JOIN {lib}.HPO ON HPH.CONO = HPO.CONO AND HPH.PONO = HPO.PONO WHERE HPH.CONO = ? AND HPH.PONO LIKE ? AND HPH.VNAME LIKE ? AND HPO.QTYRCV < HPO.QTYORD ORDER BY HPH.PODATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT LHNO, LHSTAT, CARRIER, DEST, SHIPDTE, ORDNOS, LINECT, WEIGHT FROM {lib}.LLH WHERE CONO = ? AND LHNO LIKE ? AND CARRIER LIKE ? ORDER BY SHIPDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT ITEM, ITDSC, WH, UOM, IOHB, ICOST, (IOHB * ICOST) AS STOCK_VALUE FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ? ORDER BY STOCK_VALUE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT VNAME, COUNT(DISTINCT PONO) AS PO_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN QTYRCV >= QTYORD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ON_TIME_COUNT, AVG(UPRICE) AS AVG_PRICE FROM {lib}.HPH JOIN {lib}.HPO ON HPH.CONO = HPO.CONO AND HPH.PONO = HPO.PONO WHERE HPH.CONO = ? GROUP BY VNAME ORDER BY PO_COUNT DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ?) AS TOTAL_ORDERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE CONO = ? AND HID = 'CZ') AS CLOSED_ORDERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ?) AS TOTAL_ITEMS, (SELECT SUM(IOHB * ICOST) FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ?) AS INVENTORY_VALUE

SELECT ECH.CONO, ECH.ORNO, ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, ECH.CHSTS1, ECH.CHSTS2, ECH.CHSTS3, ECH.CHSTS4, ECH.CHSTS5, ECH.HID, ECL.ITEM, ECL.ITDSC, ECL.QTORD, ECL.QTYALC, ECL.QTSHP, ECL.QTINV, ESH.SHIPDTE, ESH.SHSTAT FROM {lib}.ECH JOIN {lib}.ECL ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST LEFT JOIN {lib}.ESH ON ECL.CONO = ESH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ESH.ORNO WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ECH.ORNO = ? ORDER BY ECL.ORLN
SELECT * FROM {lib}.BBH WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO LIKE ? ORDER BY INVDATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.SIH WHERE CONO = ? AND ORNO LIKE ? ORDER BY INVDATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.WHS WHERE CONO = ? AND WHSE LIKE ? AND WHNAME LIKE ? ORDER BY WHSE FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.BIN WHERE CONO = ? AND WHSE = ? AND BINNO LIKE ? ORDER BY WHSE, BINNO FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT BIN.WHSE, BIN.BINNO, BIN.BINTYPE, BIN.STATUS, BIN.CAPACITY, IBL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IBL.QTY, IBL.LOTNO FROM {lib}.BIN LEFT JOIN {lib}.IBL ON BIN.CONO = IBL.CONO AND BIN.WHSE = IBL.WHSE AND BIN.BINNO = IBL.BINNO LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IBL.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE BIN.CONO = ? AND BIN.WHSE = ? ORDER BY BIN.BINNO FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.ITH WHERE CONO = ? AND WHSE LIKE ? AND ITEM LIKE ? ORDER BY TRNDATE DESC, TRNTIME DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT IBL.WHSE, IBL.BINNO, IBL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IBL.QTY, IBL.LOTNO, ITL.TRNDATE, ITL.ITTYP, ITL.QTY AS TRNQTY, ITL.REFNO FROM {lib}.IBL LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IBL.ITEM = IIM.ITEM LEFT JOIN {lib}.ITL ON IBL.CONO = ITL.CONO AND IBL.ITEM = ITL.ITEM AND IBL.WHSE = ITL.WHSE WHERE IBL.CONO = ? AND IBL.LOTNO LIKE ? ORDER BY ITL.TRNDATE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT BIN.WHSE, WH.WHNAME, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_BINS, SUM(CASE WHEN BIN.STATUS = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OCCUPIED, SUM(CASE WHEN BIN.STATUS = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FREE, SUM(BIN.CAPACITY) AS TOTAL_CAPACITY FROM {lib}.BIN LEFT JOIN {lib}.WHS ON BIN.CONO = WHS.CONO AND BIN.WHSE = WHS.WHSE WHERE BIN.CONO = ? GROUP BY BIN.WHSE, WH.WHNAME ORDER BY BIN.WHSE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_LINES, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(QTSHP, 0) >= COALESCE(QTORD, 0) AND COALESCE(QTORD, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FILLED_LINES, SUM(COALESCE(QTORD, 0)) AS TOTAL_ORDERED, SUM(COALESCE(QTSHP, 0)) AS TOTAL_SHIPPED, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(QTSHP, 0) < COALESCE(QTORD, 0) AND COALESCE(QTORD, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BACKORDER_LINES, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(QTSHP, 0) < COALESCE(QTORD, 0) THEN COALESCE(QTORD, 0) - COALESCE(QTSHP, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS BACKORDER_QTY FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE CONO = ?

SELECT ECL.CONO, ECL.ORNO, ECL.ORLN, ECL.ITEM, ECL.ITDSC, ECL.QTORD, ECL.QTSHP, ECL.QTYALC, (COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) - COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0)) AS QTYOPEN, ECH.CUST, ECH.REQDTE, ECH.HSTAT FROM {lib}.ECL JOIN {lib}.ECH ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO WHERE ECL.CONO = ? AND COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0) < COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) AND COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) > 0 ORDER BY ECL.ORNO, ECL.ORLN FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECL.ITEM, ECL.ITDSC, COUNT(*) AS BO_COUNT, SUM(COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) - COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0)) AS TOTAL_BO_QTY FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ECL.CONO = ? AND COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0) < COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) AND COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) > 0 GROUP BY ECL.ITEM, ECL.ITDSC ORDER BY TOTAL_BO_QTY DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_DELIVERED, SUM(CASE WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE <= ECH.REQDTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ON_TIME, SUM(CASE WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE < ECH.REQDTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EARLY, SUM(CASE WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE > ECH.REQDTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LATE, AVG(CASE WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE > ECH.REQDTE THEN ESH.SHIPDTE - ECH.REQDTE ELSE 0 END) AS AVG_LATE_DAYS FROM {lib}.ECH JOIN {lib}.ESH ON ECH.CONO = ESH.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ESH.ORNO WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ESH.SHIPDTE IS NOT NULL AND ECH.REQDTE IS NOT NULL

SELECT ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE <= ECH.REQDTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ON_TIME, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE <= ECH.REQDTE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS OTD_PCT FROM {lib}.ECH JOIN {lib}.ESH ON ECH.CONO = ESH.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ESH.ORNO LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ESH.SHIPDTE IS NOT NULL AND ECH.REQDTE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME ORDER BY OTD_PCT FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT CASE WHEN ECL.QTYALC < ECL.QTORD THEN 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK' WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE > ECH.REQDTE THEN 'SHIPPING_DELAY' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS DELAY_REASON, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM {lib}.ECH JOIN {lib}.ESH ON ECH.CONO = ESH.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ESH.ORNO JOIN {lib}.ECL ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ESH.SHIPDTE > ECH.REQDTE GROUP BY CASE WHEN ECL.QTYALC < ECL.QTORD THEN 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK' WHEN ESH.SHIPDTE > ECH.REQDTE THEN 'SHIPPING_DELAY' ELSE 'OTHER' END
SELECT SUM(QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY, COUNT(*) AS PALLET_COUNT FROM {lib}.IPI WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM = ?
SELECT SUM(QTY_ON_HAND) AS TOTAL_QTY, COUNT(*) AS LOCATION_COUNT FROM {lib}.ILI WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM = ?
SELECT PHY_STOCK_QTY AS TOTAL_QTY, 1 AS RECORD_COUNT FROM {lib}.IWM WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM = ?
SELECT PALLET, QTY, LOCATION FROM {lib}.IPI WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM = ? ORDER BY PALLET
SELECT LOCATION, QTY_ON_HAND, PALLET FROM {lib}.ILI WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM = ? ORDER BY LOCATION

SELECT IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IWI.WH, IWI.QTYOH, IIM.UNIT, IIM.UNITCOST, (COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) * COALESCE(IIM.UNITCOST, 0)) AS STOCK_VALUE, MAX(ITL.TRNDTE) AS LAST_TXN_DATE, DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(TO_DATE(MAX(ITL.TRNDTE), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS IDLE_DAYS FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM LEFT JOIN {lib}.ITL ON IWI.CONO = ITL.CONO AND IWI.ITEM = ITL.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? AND COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) > 0 GROUP BY IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IWI.WH, IWI.QTYOH, IIM.UNIT, IIM.UNITCOST HAVING MAX(ITL.TRNDTE) IS NULL OR MAX(ITL.TRNDTE) < ? ORDER BY STOCK_VALUE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(ITL.TRNDTE) IS NULL THEN 'NEVER_USED' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(TO_DATE(MAX(ITL.TRNDTE), 'YYYYMMDD')) > 365 THEN 'OVER_12M' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(TO_DATE(MAX(ITL.TRNDTE), 'YYYYMMDD')) > 180 THEN '6M_12M' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(TO_DATE(MAX(ITL.TRNDTE), 'YYYYMMDD')) > 90 THEN '3M_6M' ELSE 'UNDER_3M' END AS IDLE_BUCKET, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT, SUM(COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) * COALESCE(IIM.UNITCOST, 0)) AS TOTAL_VALUE FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM LEFT JOIN {lib}.ITL ON IWI.CONO = ITL.CONO AND IWI.ITEM = ITL.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? AND COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) > 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN MAX(ITL.TRNDTE) IS NULL THEN 'NEVER_USED' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(TO_DATE(MAX(ITL.TRNDTE), 'YYYYMMDD')) > 365 THEN 'OVER_12M' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(TO_DATE(MAX(ITL.TRNDTE), 'YYYYMMDD')) > 180 THEN '6M_12M' WHEN DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - DAYS(TO_DATE(MAX(ITL.TRNDTE), 'YYYYMMDD')) > 90 THEN '3M_6M' ELSE 'UNDER_3M' END ORDER BY TOTAL_VALUE DESC

SELECT ECL.CONO, ECL.ORNO, ECL.ORLN, ECL.ITEM, ECL.ITDSC, ECL.QTORD, ECL.QTYALC, ECL.QTSHP, ECL.QTINV, ECL.PRICE, ECL.PRICE * COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0) AS SHIP_AMOUNT, ECH.CUST, ECH.REQDTE, ECH.ORDTE, ESH.SHIPDTE, ESH.SHSTAT, ESH.LHNO, EIN.INVNO, EIN.INVDTE, EIN.INVAMT FROM {lib}.ECL JOIN {lib}.ECH ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO LEFT JOIN {lib}.ESH ON ESH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ESH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO AND ESH.ORLN = ECL.ORLN LEFT JOIN {lib}.EIN ON EIN.CONO = ECL.CONO AND EIN.ORNO = ECL.ORNO WHERE ECL.CONO = ? AND ECL.ORNO = ? ORDER BY ECL.ORLN

SELECT 'CREATED' AS EVENT_TYPE, ECH.ORDTE AS EVENT_DATE, 'Order Created' AS EVENT_DESC FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ECH.ORNO = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'SHIPPED' AS EVENT_TYPE, ESH.SHIPDTE AS EVENT_DATE, 'Shipped via ' || COALESCE(ESH.LHNO, 'N/A') AS EVENT_DESC FROM {lib}.ESH WHERE ESH.CONO = ? AND ESH.ORNO = ? AND ESH.SHIPDTE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'INVOICED' AS EVENT_TYPE, EIN.INVDTE AS EVENT_DATE, 'Invoiced: ' || COALESCE(EIN.INVNO, 'N/A') AS EVENT_DESC FROM {lib}.EIN WHERE EIN.CONO = ? AND EIN.ORNO = ? AND EIN.INVDTE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY EVENT_DATE

SELECT RCM.CONO, RCM.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, RCM.ADDR1, RCM.CITY, RCM.STATE, RCM.ZIPCD, RCM.PHONE, RCM.CONTACT, RCM.CREDLM, RCM.TERMS, RCM.TAXCODE, RCM.SLSREP, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST) AS TOTAL_ORDERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST AND ECH.HSTAT NOT IN ('8','9')) AS OPEN_ORDERS, (SELECT SUM(ECL.QTORD * ECL.PRICE) FROM {lib}.ECL JOIN {lib}.ECH ON ECH.CONO = ECL.CONO AND ECH.ORNO = ECL.ORNO WHERE ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST) AS TOTAL_REVENUE FROM {lib}.RCM WHERE RCM.CONO = ? AND RCM.CUST = ? FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECH.ORNO, ECH.ORDTE, ECH.REQDTE, ECH.HSTAT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ECL.CONO = ECH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ECH.ORNO) AS LINE_COUNT, (SELECT SUM(ECL.QTORD * ECL.PRICE) FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ECL.CONO = ECH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ECH.ORNO) AS ORDER_TOTAL FROM {lib}.ECH WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ECH.CUST = ? ORDER BY ECH.ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT EIN.INVNO, EIN.INVDTE, EIN.INVAMT, EIN.ORNO FROM {lib}.EIN WHERE EIN.CONO = ? AND EIN.CUST = ? AND EIN.INVDTE < ? ORDER BY EIN.INVDTE FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, SUM(COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0)) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) * COALESCE(IIM.UNITCOST, 0)) AS STOCK_VALUE FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? GROUP BY IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC HAVING SUM(COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) * COALESCE(IIM.UNITCOST, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY STOCK_VALUE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ITEM, ITDSC, AVG(QTY) AS AVG_DEMAND, STDDEV(QTY) AS STD_DEMAND, CASE WHEN AVG(QTY) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE STDDEV(QTY) / AVG(QTY) END AS CV FROM ( SELECT ITL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, SUM(ITL.TRNQTY) AS QTY FROM {lib}.ITL LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON ITL.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE ITL.CONO = ? AND ITL.TRNDTE >= ? GROUP BY ITL.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, ITL.TRNDTE ) SUB GROUP BY ITEM, ITDSC HAVING AVG(QTY) > 0 ORDER BY CV FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECH.CONO, ECH.ORNO, ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, ECH.ORDTE, ECH.REQDTE, ECH.HSTAT, CASE WHEN ECH.HID = 'CZ' THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN ECH.HID = 'CH' AND ECH.HSTAT = '0' THEN 'HOLD' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ECL.CONO = ECH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ECH.ORNO AND COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) > COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0)) AS BACKORDER_LINES FROM {lib}.ECH LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ECH.HID IN ('CH', 'CZ') AND ECH.HSTAT NOT IN ('8', '9') ORDER BY ECH.ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT PARENT, COMPONENT, QTY, UOM, EFFECTIVE, EXPIRED FROM {lib}.BOM WHERE CONO = ? AND COMPONENT = ? ORDER BY PARENT
SELECT PARENT, COMPONENT, QTY, UOM, EFFECTIVE, EXPIRED FROM {lib}.BOM WHERE CONO = ? AND PARENT = ? ORDER BY COMPONENT

SELECT BOM.PARENT, BOM.COMPONENT, BOM.QTY, BOM.UOM, IIM.ITDSC, IWI.QTYOH, IWI.QTYALC, (COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH,0) - COALESCE(IWI.QTYALC,0)) AS QTYAVL FROM {lib}.BOM LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON BOM.COMPONENT = IIM.ITEM LEFT JOIN {lib}.IWI ON BOM.CONO = IWI.CONO AND BOM.COMPONENT = IWI.ITEM WHERE BOM.CONO = ? AND BOM.PARENT = ? ORDER BY BOM.COMPONENT
SELECT LHNO, CARRIER, DEST, SHIPDTE, LINECT, WEIGHT, ORDNOS FROM {lib}.LLH WHERE CONO = ? ORDER BY SHIPDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.WABP WHERE CONO = ? ORDER BY WH, DAY_OF_WEEK FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM {lib}.WABP WHERE CONO = ? AND WH = ? AND DAY_OF_WEEK = ?
INSERT INTO {lib}.WABP (CONO, WH, DAY_OF_WEEK, TIME, SHPHOLD, CRHOLD, PRHOLD, ACTIVE, MAINT_USER, MAINT_DATE, MAINT_TIME) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE {lib}.WABP SET TIME = ?, SHPHOLD = ?, CRHOLD = ?, PRHOLD = ?, ACTIVE = ?, MAINT_USER = ?, MAINT_DATE = ?, MAINT_TIME = ? WHERE CONO = ? AND WH = ? AND DAY_OF_WEEK = ?
DELETE FROM {lib}.WABP WHERE CONO = ? AND WH = ? AND DAY_OF_WEEK = ?

SELECT RCMX.CUST, RCMX.RESPCSR, RCMX.ACTIVE, RCM.CUNAME FROM {lib}.RCMX LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON RCMX.CONO = RCM.CONO AND RCMX.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE RCMX.CONO = ? ORDER BY RCMX.CUST FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT RCMX.CUST, RCMX.RESPCSR, RCMX.ACTIVE, RCMX.MAINT_USER, RCMX.MAINT_DATE, RCMX.MAINT_TIME, RCM.CUNAME FROM {lib}.RCMX LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON RCMX.CONO = RCM.CONO AND RCMX.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE RCMX.CONO = ? AND RCMX.CUST = ?
INSERT INTO {lib}.RCMX (CONO, CUST, RESPCSR, ACTIVE, MAINT_USER, MAINT_DATE, MAINT_TIME) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE {lib}.RCMX SET RESPCSR = ?, ACTIVE = ?, MAINT_USER = ?, MAINT_DATE = ?, MAINT_TIME = ? WHERE CONO = ? AND CUST = ?
DELETE FROM {lib}.RCMX WHERE CONO = ? AND CUST = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.RCMX WHERE CONO = ? AND CUST = ? AND ACTIVE = 'Y'
SELECT EMPID, NAME FROM {lib}.ECSR WHERE CONO = ? ORDER BY EMPID FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT CUST, CUNAME FROM {lib}.RCM WHERE CONO = ? AND (CUST LIKE ? OR CUNAME LIKE ?) FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT WHSE, BINLOC, ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, QTYOH, STATUS FROM {lib}.ILI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON ILI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE ILI.CONO = ? ORDER BY WHSE, BINLOC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IWI.WH, IWI.QTYOH, IIM.SAFETY, (COALESCE(IIM.SAFETY,0) - COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH,0)) AS SHORTAGE, (SELECT AVG(TRNQTY) FROM {lib}.ITL WHERE ITL.ITEM = IWI.ITEM AND ITL.CONO = IWI.CONO) AS AVG_DEMAND FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? AND COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) < COALESCE(IIM.SAFETY, 0) ORDER BY SHORTAGE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM {lib}.IWI WHERE CONO = ? AND ( (COALESCE(QTYOH, 0) < COALESCE(SAFETY, 0) AND SAFETY > 0) OR (COALESCE(QTYOH, 0) > COALESCE(MAXSTK, 0) AND MAXSTK > 0) ) ORDER BY ITEM FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IWI.WH, IWI.QTYOH, IIM.UNITCOST, (COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) * COALESCE(IIM.UNITCOST, 0)) AS STOCK_VALUE FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? AND COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0) > 0 ORDER BY STOCK_VALUE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT HPO.VENDOR, HPO.VNAME, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_PO, SUM(CASE WHEN HPO.QTYRCV >= HPO.QTYORD THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ON_TIME, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN HPO.QTYRCV >= HPO.QTYORD THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS SCORE FROM {lib}.HPO WHERE HPO.CONO = ? GROUP BY HPO.VENDOR, HPO.VNAME ORDER BY SCORE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT HPH.CONO, HPH.PONO, HPH.VENDOR, HPH.VNAME, HPH.POORD, HPH.POREC, HPH.HPSTAT, HPH.HPHOLD, HPH.HPPURG, CASE WHEN HPH.HPSTAT = 'C' THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN HPH.HPHOLD = 'Y' THEN 'HOLD' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.POL WHERE POL.CONO = HPH.CONO AND POL.PONO = HPH.PONO) AS LINE_COUNT FROM {lib}.HPH WHERE HPH.CONO = ? ORDER BY HPH.POORD DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECH.CONO, ECH.ORNO, ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, ECH.ORDTE, ECH.REQDTE, ECH.HID, ECH.HSTAT, ECH.CRHOLD, ECH.SHPHOLD, ECH.PRHOLD FROM {lib}.ECH LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND (ECH.CRHOLD = 'Y' OR ECH.SHPHOLD = 'Y' OR ECH.PRHOLD = 'Y') ORDER BY ECH.ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT ECH.CONO, ECH.ORNO, ECH.CUST, RCM.CUNAME, ECH.ORDTE, ECH.REQDTE, ECH.HID, ECH.HSTAT, CASE WHEN ECH.HID = 'CZ' THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN ECH.HID = 'CH' AND ECH.HSTAT = '0' THEN 'HOLD' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ECL.CONO = ECH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ECH.ORNO AND COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) > 0) AS PENDING_LINES, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ECL.CONO = ECH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ECH.ORNO AND COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) > COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0)) AS PARTIAL_LINES, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {lib}.ECL WHERE ECL.CONO = ECH.CONO AND ECL.ORNO = ECH.ORNO AND COALESCE(ECL.QTSHP, 0) >= COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) AND COALESCE(ECL.QTORD, 0) > 0) AS SHIPPED_LINES FROM {lib}.ECH LEFT JOIN {lib}.RCM ON ECH.CONO = RCM.CONO AND ECH.CUST = RCM.CUST WHERE ECH.CONO = ? AND ECH.HID IN ('CH', 'CZ') ORDER BY ECH.ORDTE DESC FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IWI.WH, IWI.QTYOH, IWI.QTYALC, IIM.SAFETY, (COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH,0) - COALESCE(IWI.QTYALC,0)) AS QTYAVL, (SELECT SUM(POQTY - POQTYRCV) FROM {lib}.HPO WHERE HPO.ITEM = IWI.ITEM AND HPO.CONO = IWI.CONO AND COALESCE(POQTY,0) > COALESCE(POQTYRCV,0)) AS QTYONORD, MAX(ITL.TRNDTE) AS LAST_TXN_DATE FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.CONO = IIM.CONO AND IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM LEFT JOIN {lib}.ITL ON IWI.CONO = ITL.CONO AND IWI.ITEM = ITL.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? AND IWI.ITEM LIKE ? AND IIM.ITDSC LIKE ? GROUP BY IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, IWI.WH, IWI.QTYOH, IWI.QTYALC, IIM.SAFETY ORDER BY IWI.ITEM, IWI.WH FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY

SELECT IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC, SUM(COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH,0)) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(COALESCE(IWI.QTYALC,0)) AS TOTAL_ALC, MAX(COALESCE(IIM.SAFETY,0)) AS SAFETY, (SELECT AVG(TRNQTY) FROM {lib}.ITL WHERE ITL.ITEM = IWI.ITEM AND ITL.CONO = IWI.CONO AND ITL.TRNDTE >= ?) AS AVG_DEMAND FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.CONO = IIM.CONO AND IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? AND IWI.ITEM LIKE ? AND IIM.ITDSC LIKE ? GROUP BY IWI.ITEM, IIM.ITDSC HAVING SUM(COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH,0)) > 0 ORDER BY IWI.ITEM FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT SUBSTRING(TRNDTE, 1, 6) AS YM, SUM(TRNQTY) AS TOTAL_QTY FROM {lib}.ITL WHERE CONO = ? AND ITEM = ? AND TRNQTY > 0 GROUP BY SUBSTRING(TRNDTE, 1, 6) ORDER BY YM FETCH FIRST 24 ROWS ONLY
SELECT SUBSTRING(TRNDTE, 1, 6) AS YM, QTYOH, SAFETY FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.CONO = IIM.CONO AND IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? AND IWI.ITEM = ? FETCH FIRST 12 ROWS ONLY

SELECT IWI.ITEM, IWI.QTYOH, (COALESCE(IIM.SAFETY, 0) * 2 - COALESCE(IWI.QTYOH, 0)) AS SUGGESTED_QTY FROM {lib}.IWI LEFT JOIN {lib}.IIM ON IWI.CONO = IIM.CONO AND IWI.ITEM = IIM.ITEM WHERE IWI.CONO = ? ORDER BY IWI.ITEM FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
SELECT ITEM, ITDSC FROM {lib}.IIM WHERE ITEM IN (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM FROM {lib}.ITL WHERE CONO = ?) ORDER BY ITEM FETCH FIRST ? ROWS ONLY
